messages:
maria: Heads-up — bringing up tesseract7b-v2 (int4) on dedicated for Canary workload. Seeing weird memory churn and occasional OOMs when batch_size >= 6. Logs show repeated KV-alloc spikes and fragmentation after ~120s into heavy traffic.

cheng: Can you paste the exact config you used for the canary? Especially prefetch/window and max_new_tokens defaults.

maria: Sure — canary config snippet:
```
model: tesseract7b-v2-int4
batch_size: 8
max_new_tokens: 256
prefetch: 3
kv_prefetch: true
soft_reserve: 0.12
slot_compaction: auto
```
Not ideal but matches what we used for similar 7b models.

devon: Quick hypothesis: int4 kernel introduces more tiny slab allocations; combined with batch=8 it increases KV cache churn and prevents freelist coalescing. Fragmentation slowly grows until we OOM. Have you tried batch=4?

maria: Yes. With batch=4 it's stable for same traffic. With batch=8 we hit an OOM ~30m into the run. Also saw slight quality regressions on long-generation prompts for int4 vs int8 in A/B.

sophia: For the quality regression, can you run the eval suite with exact prompt seeds and track token-level diffs? Might be quantization rounding — but the memory issue sounds orthogonal.

cheng: On the mem side: try lowering prefetch from 3->1 and enable kv_eviction_threshold: 0.6 in the runtime. Also reduce max_new_tokens default to 128 for canary (to limit sequence buffer growth) and see if churn stabilizes.

maria: Running a quick smoke with batch=6, prefetch=1, max_new_tokens=128 now.

infra-bot: deployment job #4582 started: canary-tesseract7b-v2-int4 -> pool-dedicated-12.

maria: Initial numbers after 15m: batch=6, prefetch=1 seemed better — fragmentation plateaued at ~68% used vs 92% previously. No OOMs yet. Latency + token throughput down ~8% vs previous config.

devon: Tradeoff expected. If the plateau holds for 1h, I think we can 1) recommend default max_new_tokens=128 for int4 7b family, 2) add a short-term slot_compactor tweak to run more aggressively on low-util GPUs to reduce fragmentation, and 3) schedule a focused quant eval for quality deltas.

maria: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up PR with the config change proposal: set per-model defaults: {"batch_size":6, "max_new_tokens":128, "prefetch":1, "kv_eviction_threshold":0.6}. Also adding a runtime flag slot_compactor.aggr=high for this model on dedicated.

cheng: For the PR also include a small regression test: 50-run eval with long-context prompts (>=512) to catch generation divergence. If quality drop >2% we fail and we explore int8 or mixed-precision runbooks.

sophia: I'll run the eval and post the diff matrix. If we see systematic hallucination increase, we should gate the rollout.

maria: Noted. Action items: maria to open PR + telemetry alert for KV allocation rate; sophia to run eval; devon to draft slot_compactor patch; cheng to validate config on perf harness.

devon: One more note — add a canary metric: "kv_eviction_count_per_minute" and a soft-fail threshold that auto-falls back to int8 when eviction spikes. We had that saved in a doc a while back.

maria: Good call. I'll wire metrics and add the fallback policy to the rollout. If all good, we can bump to batch=8 with improved compaction in a later wave.

infra-bot: deployment job #4582 success: canary stable at 30m.

maria: Closing the thread for now; will post PR link and eval results here when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
